assessment_objectives.objective: exception requests to standards are formally submitted for review, along with a business justification for the deviation and proposed compensating controls.
the exception request undergoes a risk assessment to evaluate the business justification and proposed compensating controls.
a documented determination is made to approve or deny the exception request.
the requestor of the exception is provided a documented response on the determination, within an organization-defined period, that states any actions required of the requestor.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 10 business days after the determination is made
